_comment: Copy to ~/.config/photo-archive-organizer/config.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_language: en or tr: default folder names (Photos/Foto, Undated/Tarihsiz, Logs/Kayitlar ...)
_hash_len: hash characters in dated names; undated names use hash_len_undated
_keep_descriptive_names: keep names a person typed (Diploma.jpg) instead of renaming
_generic_name_patterns: extra regexes (full match on the name without extension) that may be renamed
_min_year: earliest plausible capture year; earlier or future dates are treated as a broken clock
_similar_threshold: Vision distance counted as the same picture; up to review_threshold is only listed
_raw_policy: keep = RAW files with a JPEG twin are only listed; similar = offered for removal
_quicktime_utc: treat QuickTime CreateDate as UTC (spec) instead of local time (many cameras)
_trust_existing_names: do not re-read files already named <date>_<hash> by this tool
_separate_screenshots: screenshots go to <year>/Screenshots instead of month folders
_albums: folder names (anywhere) or relative paths that must stay as they are
_device_owners: camera model -> person, shown by the devices command
_roots: names for places, so you can say 'Anna on the backup disk'
